remainingWake.title: Remaining wake time
remainingWake.intro: Set when the app transitions between Active, Winding Down, and Pre-Sleep modes. A fourth header phase (Sleep, moon) appears automatically when you log bed or fell-asleep before wake—it is not controlled here. Percentages are your share of wake time remaining for the first three; sample times use your 7-day average.
remainingWake.defaultsAria: Reset remaining wake thresholds to defaults: {open}% and {winding}%

phase.sleepHint: A fourth header phase (moon) appears automatically when you log bed or fell-asleep before wake. It is not controlled by these sliders.

remainingWake.leftThumbAria: Active until {percent}% wake time remains, around {time} with your 7-day averages
remainingWake.rightThumbAria: Winding down until {percent}% wake time remains, around {time} with your 7-day averages
remainingWake.headsUpIntro: Shows a small note when the next phase (☀️Active → 🌇Winding → 🛏️Pre-sleep) is approaching.
remainingWake.headsUpDefaultAria: Reset phase change heads-up to default: 30 minutes before

tonightGuidance.title: Tonight guidance
tonightGuidance.intro: When you have a saved Tonight target, guidance moves your schedule gradually from your recent average toward that target (see About). Turn it off to use the full target immediately.
tonightGuidance.paceIntro: How many minutes per day the schedule may shift toward your target (each of sleep and wake).

tonight.naturalAverageAria: Tonight follows your recent average; no saved target

tonight.switchTitle: This clears your saved Tonight target and moves the sliders to your recent average.
tonight.toastSwitchAverage: Using recent average; saved Tonight target cleared
tonight.toastRecentAverage: Using recent average sleep and wake times

remainingWake.title: 残り覚醒時間
remainingWake.intro: 活動中・リラックスタイム・就寝前の切り替えを設定します。4つ目のヘッダー段階（睡眠・月）は、起床前にベッドまたは入眠を記録すると自動で表示され、ここでは調整しません。割合は最初の3段階の残り覚醒時間で、時刻の目安は直近7日平均です。
